name: tracer: a protected write in fully-autonomous goes through decide() to an ask with no grant, and comes out as a valid decision record
tracer: the same protected write with nobody present is denied, and the floor decided it
a plain edit with no floor fact is decided by the settings layer alone
a failed-closed bundle leaves read and plan to the settings layer and denies everything else with its own sentence
a run with no gate host (the unavailable state) is refused everything but read and plan under its own rule id, with its own sentence
a failed-closed bundle keeps the floor: a read of the key folder is still refused with no card
effectiveMode is the lower of the setting and the ceiling, in the fixed order
a ceiling of approve-risky for the interactive context makes a fully-autonomous setting behave as approve-risky, and settings never widen it
the ceiling refuses a verb in a context it does not list, and a verb it does not list at all
a tool whose manifest does not list the context is refused, and a listed one is not
an MCP tool outside the interactive context needs its server on the ceiling list
a label refusal from the caller denies with its own rule and reason
the floor is always enforced: the inputs that shadow mode only reported now ask or refuse in every mode, and everything else decides as before
no option turns the floor off: decide() ignores the old shadow option if it is handed one
source scan: no production file under src names a floor mode, so nothing can put the floor in shadow again (GATE-05, D-19)
GATE_RULE_IDS lists every rule id once, including the floor, bundle, manifest, label, route, taint and settings ids
an empty effect list with a valid bundle and a person present asks with its own rule, no always-allow, no run-wide grant, and never reaches the settings layer
an empty effect list with nobody present, or in an unattended context, is denied with a plain reason and never reaches the settings layer
an empty effect list is never asked past a failed-closed bundle, keeps its own rule over a valid bundle, and the emergency stop still comes first
a call whose effects are unknown is still refused with no card when what it names reaches a credential store or the identity folders
a settings refusal on the request beats every ask, and the emergency stop beats it
a failed-closed policy and a deny-list refusal: the deny list is named
unknown effects with a label verdict: denied with the verdict, after a floor refusal by name, before a settings refusal, the outside-workspace refusal and the ask
